differences.notes: Source: src/components/FormattedDate.astro renders <time datetime={date.toISOString()}> where the Date is parsed from frontmatter in the build machine's local TZ. Under TZ=Pacific/Auckland (UTC+12, NZST) a local-midnight date serializes as the previous day 12:00:00 UTC. The visible text uses date.toLocaleDateString('en-us', ...) with a hardcoded locale, so LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 produced no change; all D1 regions are TZ-only. 19 merged regions across the 9 files, all the same shift pattern (e.g. '8T00'->'7T12', '7-01T00'->'6-30T12'). rss.xml pubDates show the same -12h shift.
